children.text: Application -
Step 1:
Go to the
official website
of the Jammu & Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Step 2:
Click on
"Login,"
enter your details, and sign in to your account.
Step 3:
After logging in, click on "Scheme Registration" and select "Apply for Scheme."
Step 4:
Choose the scheme you wish to apply for in order to avail the benefits.
Step 5:
Enter all required information and upload the necessary documents as prompted.
Step 6:
Finally, click on "Submit Application" to complete the process.
Status Tracking -
Applicant can track their application status online through the
official website
of the  Jammu & Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Relevant updates will be sent to the registered mobile number.

applicationProcess.process_md:
***Application -*** **Step 1:** Go to the [official website ](https://www.jkbocw.gov.in/Index.aspx)of the Jammu & Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. **Step 2:** Click on ["Login,"](https://portal.jkbocw.gov.in/LoginGuest.aspx) enter your details, and sign in to your account. **Step 3:** After logging in, click on "Scheme Registration" and select "Apply for Scheme." **Step 4:** Choose the scheme you wish to apply for in order to avail the benefits. **Step 5:** Enter all required information and upload the necessary documents as prompted. **Step 6:** Finally, click on "Submit Application" to complete the process.
***Status Tracking -*** Applicant can track their application status online through the [official website](https://www.jkbocw.gov.in/Index.aspx) of the Jammu & Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Relevant updates will be sent to the registered mobile number.

children.text: Step 1:

The interested applicant should visit the JKBOCWWB office during office hours and request a hard copy of the prescribed application form from the staff responsible for issuing and collecting filled-in applications.
OR
The interested applicant can print the Scheme
application form
(Page no. 19).
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all mandatory fields, paste a passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the required documents to the Assistant Labour Commissioner  (ALC ) of your district.
Step 4:

Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority upon submission. Ensure the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).
NOTE:
Ensure that the application is submitted within the prescribed period, if any.

children.text: For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:
The applicant should be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir.
The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
The applicant should be registration is renewed annually.
For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:
The applicant should be a nominee/dependent of a registered member/worker who has passed away due to accidental death.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The "Registered BOC Workers in Case of Accidental Death" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial assistance to the nominee or dependents of registered BOC workers in the event of accidental death.

children.text: Launched on 1st January 2018, the scheme "Registered BOC Workers in Case of Accidental Death" is a Welfare Scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir. Through this scheme, financial assistance of ₹4,00,000/- is provided to the nominee or dependents of registered BOC workers in the event of an accidental death. The applications are accepted online as well as offline.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: Launched on 1st January 2018, the scheme "Registered BOC Workers in Case of Accidental Death" is a Welfare Scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir. Through this scheme, financial assistance of ₹4,00,000/- is provided to the nominee or dependents of registered BOC workers in the event of an accidental death. The applications are accepted online as well as offline.
